_comment: Settings of the paper's real-robot trials. They relax the conservative defaults: no tracking guard, no table checks, the fast 'throw' motion profile. Read docs/safety.md first. The tracking limit was not recorded in the trial logs; 0 was the code default at the time. The bottle-cap stages tighten the pose tolerance to 3 mm / 3 deg themselves. Apply with: urai-robot --settings configs/paper-settings.json, or PUT this body (without _comment) to /api/settings.
